annotations.title: Uniswap pool liquidity: reserves and price

description: Uniswap pool liquidity for a token pair: every Uniswap v3 pool by fee tier with its in-range liquidity, both token balances held, price and current tick, deepest first, read live on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Use to check a pool's depth before a swap or to price a token from its pool. Example: tokenA=WETH, tokenB=USDC. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
